snp2.9:1.1: Kiṃsīlasutta. "Kiṃsīlo kiṃsamācāro kāni kammāni brūhayaṃ naro sammāviviṭṭh' assa uttamatthañ ca pāpuṇe". || ||
snp2.9:2.1: "Vaddhāpacāyī anusuyyako siyā, kālaññu c' assa garunaṃ dassanāya, dhammiṃ kathaṃ erayitaṃ khaṇaññū suṇeyya sakkacca subhāsitāni. || ||
snp2.9:3.1: Kālena gacche garunaṃ sakāsaṃ thambhaṃ niraṃkatvā nivātavutti,| atthaṃ dhammaṃ saññamaṃ brahmacariyaṃ anussare c' eva samācare ca. || ||
snp2.9:4.1: Dhammārāmo dhammarato dhamme ṭhito dhammavinicchayaññū n' evācare dhammasandosavādaṃ tacchehi niyyetha subhāsitehi. || ||
snp2.9:5.1: Hassaṃ jappaṃ paridevaṃ padosaṃ māyākataṃ kuhanaṃ giddhimānaṃ sārambha-kakkassa-kasāva-mucchaṃ hitvā care vītamado ṭhitatto. || ||
snp2.9:6.1: Viññātasārāni subhāsitāni, sutañ ca viññātaṃ samādhisāraṃ, -- na tassa paññā ca sutañ ca vaḍḍhati, yo sāhaso hoti naro pamatto. || ||
snp2.9:7.1: Dhamme ca ye ariyapavedite ratā anuttarā te vacasā manasā kammanā ca, te santi-soracca-samādhisaṇṭhitā sutassa paññāya ca sāram ajjhagū" ti || || KIṂSĪLASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
